_comment: Which of mxm-folded-spring's parameters fill the collection's control roles.
Roles come from docs/MXM_CONTROL_MAP.md, which is normative; parameters are named by
their permanent string id, never by display name.
`fx.reverb` already existed for the built-in spring's level, and this plugin's Level is the
same quantity, so it fills the role rather than adding one.
`fx.reverb_tank` is new, appended into the Effects page's LAST free slot in the same change
as this plugin - the rule under which a plugin may claim a role (section 9). It is stepped,
three positions, and it is a performance control: changing tank is the one thing this effect
does besides get louder. The page is now full; the next effect that wants a role needs a page.
`feedback` is deliberately unmapped. The page is full, and it is also the one control here
that wants a hand on it rather than a knob somebody may have assigned elsewhere.
